perks.name: Master of Arms

perks.name: Desperate Measures

perks.desc: Hitting three separate targets increases damage for a moderate duration.

perks.name: Onslaught
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon increase its rate of fire.

perks.name: Frame of Reference
perks.desc: Final blows with this weapon temporarily grant increased damage, reload speed, and range. This effect is frozen in time while the weapon is stowed.

notes: Constructed by @Adamsdown_Boy (PvE PvE-Minor PvE-GroupAdd PvE-God Stasis-Build M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing groups of Minor adds in activities rated Normal difficulty, particularly for Stasis builds. Intercalary is an adaptive auto rifle, which are rated B-Tier for endgame PvE by @TheAegisRelic Endgame Analysis Spreadsheet​, who says "probably best overall auto archetype accounting for barrier intrinsic and damage profile". The frame intrinsic offers built in Anti-Barrier, but offers no bonuses beyond being "well-rounded, reliable and sturdy" as per the Destiny Data Compendium. The recoil direction is right of vertical and loose so you could improve Recoil Direction or look to boost Stability with the barrel perk to help hit crits, or Handling if you can land your shots. In the magazine perk slot, the combat effect perks work well, or look for perks that improve mag size or Reload Speed. For Stasis synergy, in the first trait perk column Headstone generates a Stasis crystal on a crit kill, these are weapon-generated entities so can inherit damage buffs, and proc weapon traits and subclass fragments when shattered for AoE damage. In the second column, for more Stasis synergy Rimestealer generates ×2 stacks of Stasis Frost Armor on shattering a Stasis crystal or killing a frozen enemy. Otherwise, for damage Desperate which Measures provides up to ×3 stacks for max ×1.3 damage for a refreshable 7.5s for a weapon and then two ability kills, or Master of Arms which provides ×1.15 damage for 8s after a kill with any weapon, with a second stack of ×1.25 for 5s on any kills with the first stack active. Aegis ranks the Frame of Reference origin trait as A-Tier for PvE - it stacks up to ×5 times on kills, providing up to ×1.07 damage and boosts to Reload Speed and Range for 8s, with the timer pausing when the weapon's stowed. If you're interested, the name is derived from the Latin intercalārius, combining inter ("between") and calāre ("to call out or proclaim"), and ties into Desert Perpetual's time-themed naming. An "intercalary day", better known as a leap day, is artificially inserted into a calendar to keep human timekeeping aligned with natural astronomical cycles. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with your preferred choice of mod to boost weapon stats, ammo generation, or elemental pickups for builds.

Inspired by @CourtProjects, @Saint_Kabr and @ImpetusAlways (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE roll for clearing minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with a Stasis build. Intercalary's frame intrinsic doesn't offer any specific benefit other than just being "well-rounded". The stats are good by comparison with its peers, and they're helped further at Tier 4/5 when barrel and magazine perks are enhanced - see https://d2foundry.gg/w/2725426834 for how the weapon stats impact in-game performance. From @mossy_max's spreadsheet (https://destiny2.science/reserves), base mag size is 42 (max 60). The Recoil Direction is a bit wonky, so use the barrel perk to try and control that a little. You have the full range of combat effect magazine perks to choose from, or look for one that helps with reload. For something to synergise with a Stasis build, in the first trait perk column Headstone generates a Stasis crystal on a crit kill, which can be shattered for AoE damage and to proc stasis ability effects. You can then pair this with Rimestealer to generate a stack (2 stacks when enhanced) of Frost Armor on shattering a Stasis crystal or killing a frozen enemy. Alternatively, as the damage from a crystal shatter inherits any weapon damage modifier, One For All boosts damage by ×1.35 for a non-refreshable 10s (11s when enhanced) after hitting three separate targets within 3s of each. The Frame of Reference Origin Trait stacks up to ×5 times on kills, providing up to ×1.07 damage and boosts to Reload Speed and Range for 8s, with the timer pausing when the weapon's stowed. If you're interested, "Intercalary" refers to a day inserted in a calendar year to bring it in line with the solar year, so 29th February is an intercalary day in leap years. Recommended MW: Handling, with your preferred choice of mod/enhanced mod to boost mag size, weapon stats, ammo regeneration, or elemental pickups for builds - and don't forget to check any available seasonal fragile mods.
